# TransUnion SmartMove

> > TransUnion SmartMove is a comprehensive tenant screening platform that delivers background checks, credit reports, criminal history, eviction records, and risk scoring to help landlords and property managers make informed rental decisions.

SmartMove offers landlords, property managers, and real estate agents a suite of integrated screening tools powered by TransUnion's data and analytics. The platform combines credit checks, criminal background reports, eviction history, income verification, and proprietary risk scoring to streamline tenant vetting and ensure FCRA compliance.

- Tenant Screening
